name: EMP rifle
body:
Source Technology Guide pg. 21
Statistics
Cost 24,000 gp
Type two-handed ranged; Proficiency exotic (firearms); Weight 6 lbs.
Damage 2d6 (small), 3d6 (medium); Damage Type E; Critical x2
Range 150 ft.; Capacity 20; Usage 1 charge; Special Automatic, touch
Description
An EMP rifle is a larger, more powerful version of an EMP pistol. It emits a beam of electromagnetic energy that can’t harm living creatures, but deals significant damage to robots. It functions as an EMP pistol except for the differences listed here.
Construction
Craft DC 29; Cost 12,000 gp
Craft Technological Arms and Armor, military lab
